We are looking for a driven and ambitious Senior Business Development Executive to join a growing organisation within the energy sector.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced sales professional to win new business, develop customer relationships and grow a portfolio of mid-market and SME clients.

The Role
- Generate new business through proactive outbound sales, cold calling and self-generated leads.
- Manage and develop a portfolio of SME and mid-market customers.
- Build relationships with key decision-makers and negotiate energy supply contracts.
- Manage your own sales pipeline, forecasts and sales targets.
- Engage with customers via telephone, email and occasional face-to-face meetings.
- Build relationships with energy supplier partners and deliver excellent customer service.
- Attend networking events and field-based meetings where required.

About You
- Minimum 2 years' sales experience, within B2 B.
- Experience in the Energy industry is desirable, similar/transferrable industry experience will be considered.
- Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets.
- Excellent communication, relationship-building and negotiation skills.
- Confident engaging with business decision-makers.
- Strong pipeline management and organisational skills.
- Self-motivated, resilient and results-driven.

What's on Offer?
- Uncapped commission.
- Early finish on Fridays.
- Friendly, supportive working environment.
- Regular company events.

If you're a target-driven sales professional looking for your next opportunity with excellent earning potential, send your CV to Lily at Viqu Energy today!

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Co-ordinator
- Job Type: Full-time, permanent
- Location: Office-based, 5 days per week
- Salary: 28,000 - 30,000 plus annual company bonus

A growing international manufacturer within the building services sector is looking to appoint Internal Sales Co-ordinators to join its internal sales team. These Internal Sales Co-ordinator opportunities are ideal for someone with strong customer service, order processing and administrative experience who enjoy working in a busy technical environment. The role focuses on managing enquiries, quotations and orders, while building long-term customer relationships and supporting a smooth journey from enquiry to completion.

Day-to-day of the role
- Handle incoming customer enquiries by phone and email, providing a high standard of service at all times.
- Process quotations, sales orders, purchase orders, confirmations and collections accurately and efficiently.
- Manage around 15-20 orders per day across parts and complete systems, ensuring prompt turnaround.
- Support the external sales team with customer, product and project-related enquiries.
- Maintain accurate CRM records, including customer details, project updates and won or lost opportunities.
- Provide technical product information and guidance, relaying advice clearly and accurately to customers.
- Liaise with warehouse, logistics and internal departments to ensure orders are processed smoothly.
- Monitor shared inboxes and ensure all queries and documentation are handled in a timely manner.
- Assist with smaller customer projects and general sales administration as required.
- In the first six months, help improve CRM processes, build product knowledge and become a key contact for order processing and enquiries.

Required skills & qualifications
- At least 2 years' experience in internal sales, sales support, customer service or sales coordination.
- Proven experience processing customer quotations and sales orders accurately.
- Strong administration, organisational and time management skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build lasting customer relationships.
- Confident working independently, taking ownership of tasks and managing a varied workload.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office; CRM system experience would be advantageous.
- Experience in building services, plumbing, drainage, electrical or another technical product environment would be beneficial.
- Sage 200 experience, exposure to CAD, or the ability to read technical plans and drawings would be an advantage.
- A proactive, resourceful and detail-focused approach, with a strong team ethic and can-do attitude.

Benefits
- Annual company performance bonus
- Healthcare scheme
- Company pension
- 24 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Free onsite parking
- Company-provided uniform
- Ongoing training, mentoring and genuine career development opportunities

How to apply

To apply for this Sales Co-ordinator position, please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and why this role is of interest to you.

- Manage the requirements and expectations of customers throughout the house buying process,

SALES ADVISOR REQUIREMENTS:
- Experience of high-performance in a Sales role

- Experienced in problem solving and the ability to analyse/report on issues that could affect the development
- Able to rapidly assimilate and assess situations and issues, offering solutions with maximum results

WHAT WE OFFER:
- Competitive basic salary
- 26 days annual leave + public holidays + your birthday off
- Excellent commission structure
- Company contribute 6.5% to your pension, plus other benefits

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Sales Development Representative
Location: Stratford-upon-Avon
Salary: Starting from £28,000 per annum
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm

Company Overview
Operating within the technology and data solutions sector, this business helps organisations access specialist solutions that support their commercial objectives. With a focus on business growth, customer relationships and collaborative partnerships, the company offers a supportive environment where individuals can develop their sales expertise and contribute to long-term success.
About the Role
An exciting opportunity is available for a motivated Sales Development Representative to join a growing team in the cybersecurity and data protection sector. This office-based role in Stratford-upon-Avon focuses on generating new business across a designated UK territory, using telephone, email and LinkedIn to engage prospective customers. You ll help identify sales opportunities, support customer relationships and develop your knowledge of SaaS solutions and IT infrastructure, with ongoing training and support from an experienced team.
Duties & Responsibilities
- Identify and engage new business prospects across your designated UK territory through LinkedIn, email and telephone outreach.
- Be the first point of contact for potential customers, introducing the business and its services.
- Understand prospects technology needs and identify potential sales opportunities.
- Record detailed notes in the CRM system and qualify leads for the Sales Executive team.
- Support lead generation campaigns linked to vendor partnerships and marketing initiatives.
- Take part in ongoing product and sales training provided by vendor partners.
- Keep up to date with new and emerging technologies within the technology sector.

Education & Skills Required
- Previous experience in sales or a customer-facing role is beneficial.
- Confident written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage potential customers by phone, email and LinkedIn.
- Comfortable using Microsoft Outlook and Excel; CRM experience is desirable.
- Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and good time management.
- A proactive, self-motivated approach with an interest in technology and generating new business.
- A positive team player with a willingness to learn, develop new skills and embrace ongoing training.
- An interest in technology solutions, B2 B sales or vendor partnerships would be beneficial.

Additional Information
- Office-based role, Monday Friday 9am 5pm (located near Stratford Parkway Station)
- Full time, permanent position
- 22 days holiday, plus bank holidays
- Unlimited access to professional training from industry vendors
- Company Pension Scheme
- On-site parking

Please note this role includes following both cold and warm leads, so you must be comfortable in a sales-based position and confident on the phone.

- Engage with and maintain strong relationships with prospects and customers through telephone, email, social media
- Gain valuable market intelligence to support the direct marketing team
- Organise, generate and sending mailings for the business
- Generate leads amongst prospects for sales execs and recruitment team
- Provide a high level of service internally and externally

The ideal candidate for the Telesales & Marketing Assistant:
- The most important qualities for this role are a proactive attitude, resilience and confidence to pick up the phone
- Previous experience in a B2 B telephone environment would be advantageous
- Comfortable speaking to people at all levels
- Must be IT literate - experience with CRM systems
- Can work in a team environment under pressure
